children: DALLAS, Nov. 11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The board of directors of Kimberly-Clark Corporation (
) has declared a regular quarterly dividend of $1.28 per share. The dividend is payable in cash on January 5, 2027, to stockholders of record at the close of business on December 4, 2026.
Kimberly-Clark has paid a dividend for 92 consecutive years and has increased its dividend for 54 consecutive years.
The company also announced that it will hold its next annual shareholder meeting on May 13, 2027.

Our portfolio of iconic personal care and consumer health brands, including Huggies, Listerine, Cottonelle, Neutrogena, Depend, Tylenol, Kleenex, Johnson's, Kotex and Scott, serves consumers across every stage of life in more than 175 countries. We combine consumer-led innovation, leading brand-building and commercial capabilities, and a fast and agile operating model to raise the standard of care for billions of people around the world. We are committed to using sustainable practices designed to support a healthy planet, build strong communities, and enable our business to thrive for decades to come. The KMB stock is a large cap growth and value stock and core S&P 500 equity held by more than 400 Exchange Traded Funds. Kimberly-Clark is considered a Dividend Aristocrat, having paid a dividend for 92 consecutive years and increasing its dividend in each of the past 54 consecutive years. To keep up with the latest news and learn more about the company's more than 150-year history, visit kimberly-clark.com
